'''Ascalon Arena''' is a [[PvP]] arena located within Post-[[Searing]] [[Ascalon City]].

{{Quotation|game|
For hundreds of years, heroes of all stripes have been coming to the Arenas in times of peace to practice and hone their skills. The Ascalon Arena is one of the best places for new heroes to train and learn the basics of arena combat.
}}

==Description==
Players start on opposing sides of the map. The geography of this arena consists of rugged, steeply sloped terrain with a large tar pond in the center.

===Arena Rules===
* Maximum Character Level Allowed: 10
* Team Size: 4
* Teams are selected randomly.
